panels.description: The selected check's native unit, kind and threshold direction. Threshold values and enabled checks are configured in the collector.

panels.title: Check status and catalog
panels.description: All catalog checks in this group. Not collected / disabled also covers collector outages or checks not yet evaluated. Unknown is an evaluated check with unavailable results. Numeric values use native catalog units; event-only checks have no state value.

targets.expr: ((max by (check) (label_replace((data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"${environment:regex}",sql_instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1), "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)"))) or on(check) (data_eyes_check_info{group="Availability"} * 0 - 1)) * on(check) group_left(name,kind,unit,direction) data_eyes_check_info{group="Availability"}

panels.title: Check status and catalog
panels.description: All catalog checks in this group. Not collected / disabled also covers collector outages or checks not yet evaluated. Unknown is an evaluated check with unavailable results. Numeric values use native catalog units; event-only checks have no state value.

targets.expr: ((max by (check) (label_replace((data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"${environment:regex}",sql_instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1), "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)"))) or on(check) (data_eyes_check_info{group="Backup & integrity"} * 0 - 1)) * on(check) group_left(name,kind,unit,direction) data_eyes_check_info{group="Backup & integrity"}

(data_eyes_check_value{environment=~"${environment:regex}",sql_instance=~"${instance:regex}"} * on(check) group_left(name,unit) data_eyes_check_info{group="Backup & integrity"}) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)

(increase(data_eyes_check_events_total{environment=~"${environment:regex}",sql_instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__range]) * on(check) group_left(name) data_eyes_check_info{group="Backup & integrity"}) and on() (max(up{job="data-eyes"}) == 1)

description: One server at a time. Database/drive filters apply to labeled database and I/O panels; health and server totals remain server-wide. Missing values are unavailable, never healthy.
